An '''RK-9 soil devastator''' was a type of chemical weapon that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to ravage the soil of enemy farmland, rendering it incapable of supporting life. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Torsin]]'s unit was given soil devastators in case they were unable to capture the [[Stillwater Farms]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and Imperial forces used the soil devastators after Torsin's [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
